top_signals.title: Copper Climbs From Record-High Close With Supply Still Tight
top_signals.summary: Copper extended gains — after closing a a record high on Tuesday — as short-term supplies continued to look tight despite an easing of last week’s severe market squeeze.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
top_signals.summary: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
